youtube.title: JOSHUA RILEY
youtube.summary: Joshua Riley of Sovereign joins Paul Brennan to discuss the election aftermath, defending RCR’s role in countering Te Pāti Māori’s electorate-vote strategy. He argues National misled voters by encouraging party votes that could not deliver additional MPs and questions its commitment to MMP. He also outlines what ACT and NZ First should demand in coalition negotiations, particularly on immigration, digital ID and policies he believes threaten New Zealand’s sovereignty.
